ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in Central America and the Caribbean changed by +0.249 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.182 to +0.317), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.615 °C.

cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Water running off the surface
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water running off the surface in Central America and the Caribbean changed by −0.0084 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.0145 to −0.0022), which is statistically significant (p = 0.0081). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is a decrease of about 0.0207 mm/day.

ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in Central America and the Caribbean shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.17): the estimate is −0.12 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −0.29 to +0.05). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in Central America and the Caribbean shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.77): the estimate is −0.008 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.060 to +0.044). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in Central America and the Caribbean shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.90): the estimate is −0.001 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.015 to +0.013). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
